title: Decision (v0)
description: Accept or decline, terminating a negotiation branch. An 'accept' on a valid, unexpired offer is what triggers Commitment formation and escrow (docs/spec/01 §P7). A decline reason, if given, is a coarse category code — never free text about the counterparty (docs/design.md §6: rejection reasons stay private).

decline_reason.description: Coarse code only. Compatibility declines must not reveal the specific reason to the other party.
